dedupe_keys.name: dataset for publication measuring harmonics with inductive voltage transformers in presence of subharmonics

description: Gabriella Crotti and colleagues publish this resource through the source community. The spreadsheet supplies data for Figures 9–16 of IEEE paper 10.1109/TIM.2021.3111995, which examines harmonic measurement by inductive voltage transformers in the presence of subharmonics. Coverage is the plotted experimental results rather than a claimed complete raw acquisition archive. The native metadata do not list all operating points or numerical units. Its power-quality modelling role is validation of transformer behaviour under mixed-frequency signals. The later standards-compliance dataset addresses a related but separately deposited study. Zenodo supplies the deposited data and native file inventory with open access under cc-by-4.0. Sample values, linked files and code were not read or executed during source checks. A limitation is that complete implementation or measurement settings cannot be reconstructed from descriptive metadata alone. Related experimental components and publications retain their distinct roles; separate deposits are not assumed to provide independent observations.
